ev.q: During 1990–2011, a total of 504 cases of TBRF were reported to CDC.
The median number of cases per year was 20, with a range of 14 in 1993 to 45 in 2002.
Most (74%) patients had onset of illness during June–September
In Texas, cases occurred more frequently (67%) during November–March
215 (66%) of these cases were reported among nonresident visitors to the counties of exposure
This report summarizes the epidemiology of 504 TBRF cases reported from 12 western states during 1990–2011.

methods_quotes.q: TBRF case data for these 12 states for the period 1990–2011 were compiled
County of residence and county of exposure were known for 325 (64%) cases
